target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (v : ℝ → E → E) (K : NNReal) (f g : ℝ → E) (a b : ℝ), (∀ t, LipschitzWith K (v t)) → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt f (v t (f t)) (Set.Ici t) t) → ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt g (v t (g t)) (Set.Ici t) t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, dist (f t) (g t) ≤ dist (f a) (g a) * Real.exp (K * (t - a))
